reviews.x: I love this hair ! It's soft and well packaged it definately deserved the 5 stars so tip it may look like it's not a lot but it's enough you may need 2 orders so 6 bundles. I included a picture to show how it looks when separated.
This hair was easy to work with and I loved how the color was blended together. I only used 1.5 packs.  I will definitely be purchasing again. Great quality for a great price!!!

I do hair and I've been on the hunt for the perfect spring twist hair. I mostly do natural hair protective styles and this hair is perfect. I will definitely be recommending to my clients. It's perfect for spring twists. It's very soft and easy to manage and it mimics the texture of natural hair (I have 4c hair) perfectly.I only needed half of the three bundles for shoulder length spring twist. Shipping  was fast and customer service is amazing..you won't regret it.

I bought this hair to do individual spring twists. I like it. Although it looks straight silky, when it’s stretched and installed, it looks very natural. It resembles marley hair, except it’s softer and more manageable. I also bought this hair from Beyond Beauty on Amazon; however, this brand had more hair per twist.

reviews.t: The hair is absolutely beautiful, I love the quality and color
reviews.x: My order arrived in 4 days. It arrived neatly packaged and undamaged.  The hair is absolutely beautiful, I love the quality and color, 1B/27, it's very springy and when stretch it is very long. I cut in half and it still reaches past my collar bone. I used one and a half packs so have enough left for another instal.  I've had them in for two weeks and get compliments all the time. I love them and will definitely be ordering more!

reviews.t: The style came out very cute.
reviews.x: Nice bouncy hair, but tangles and knots very easily. I ordered 1b-30 and I loooove the color. Remember to twist with the curl, never against. Look up “the right way to spring twist” by BeautycanBraid on YouTube for tips on how to achieve the prefect twist.

I’ve gotten so many compliments while having in this hair. It looks incredibly natural as if I have normal two stand twists in. It’s also super light and flexible unlike when I get Marley or Senegalese twists. I watched lots of YouTube tutorials that say to split the strand in half and use one half for each twist but the stylist used one strand per twist for me. So I ended up using the entire three packs but if you split you’ll certainly have enough.  I’m planning on wearing this style until end

reviews.t: Okay if you like to work
reviews.x: The hair was a little tedious to work with it tangled easily most of the hair went in the trash the strands were inconsistent some were really skinny and some were thick I found myself having to put together two skinny ones to make one whole I think I'll stick with the Eon brand hair.

The color is not as displayed. AT ALL. Texture is perfect for spring, bomb, fluffy twist BUT THE COLOR IS NOT AS ADVERTISED. I will not buy colored hair again. It’s not ombré it’s throughout the entire strand.
[[VIDEOID:cfa29e79bb203f635e68ea9df8bc276b]] Beautiful hair! This will be easy to do crochets with. The hair is nice and full. Cheaper than the Beauty Supply Store. No smell

Haven't install it yet but looks very nice and soft.  I counted 20 strands in one pack.  The hair is long and folded in half.  You can either use it as is or cut the half to have more hair but bare in mind it will be shorter.  Hair looks exactly as shown very springy and bouncy and it arrived fast.  Three bundles make one pack.  So in all its 60 strands in total not 60 in a single bundle as advertised.

I love this, it’s fluffy and light weight.  I used two out of the three pcs per pack for my entire head  The hair without being cut rests at about a shoulder length so you may have to cut into equal halves if you want to go shorter

reviews.t: Wonderful Beautiful Hair for Spring Twists
reviews.x: I love this hair - very easy to installed.  I cut the strings into half and only took 1 1/2 bundles to complete my look.  Adding hair decorations really make this hair look even more beautiful.  I received so many compliments on this hairstyle.  Also this hair is very lightweight and bouncy - especially for the summer.  I love this hair so much, that I ordered two more packs - just in case Becolor Hair runs out.  Yes, I will recommend this hair and you will not regret it.

This product had an odd smell to it. I didn’t feel comfortable installing without first soaking the hair with a mild shampoo. Smell faded mostly after. Hair did well with the soaking and didn’t frizz much. Overall pleased with purchase. Smooth pull apart used for spring twists hairstyle. I have a lot of hair and used a pack and a half

reviews.t: This hair was extremely rough and dry. I also ...
reviews.x: This hair was extremely rough and dry. I also thought the hair was sort of an ombre color but the color 30 is through out the hair. My stylist had a very hard time using this hair.
Soft, light and easy to work with.  I'll be buying this again.

reviews.t: This is all you need for a style
reviews.x: I was so skeptical when I received these bundles and wondered if I should have ordered more. You do not, this was just enough as others have stated and the hair was great to work with. I have no problem with recommending this hair and ordering more in the future. I do my hair very often and used this hair on a friend of mines and the twist turned out beautifully. She wore this style for about 6-8 weeks, no problem.

I drove to 4 different beauty supply stores looking for gray hair this texture and could not find it anywhere! I’m glad I decided to order this item! It blended perfectly with my grandma’s hair and was easy to work with. The hair did not have an odor. I rinsed it with acv and water and my grandma has not had any scalp irritation complaints! I will be buying again.

It was my first time  doing a twist out in my hair, I got alot of compliment,  most people thought it was my real hair i only use one bundle of hair to do my head. I cut one strand  in to two and use them individually in my hair. There is a lot of tutorial on YouTube on how to do this sort of thing.

Ordered hair in color 1b. It was easy to separate and twist. I used a moisturizer and water to twist. Very easy. I bought this product for medium spring twists. I had lots of compliments. Also, I didn't have to use all the hair. I had 1/3 of my last pack left.  I will order again. Thanks.

reviews.t: Use them as they come in and change the style later
reviews.x: I apologize. I forgot to write a review after I have gotten the hair.  I LOVE THIS HAIR!! I have used it in so many ways and still have them for future use until they cannot be used anymore. I was satisfied with the product. And would order from them again if I need too.

reviews.t: This hair is amazing left it in longer than I should have got ...
reviews.x: This hair is amazing left it in longer than I should have got it wet & it was good.. if your doing crochet your going to need 2-3buddles I ended up going to the store to get 2 packs to finish my hair
This hair it's horrible! I finally installed it and at first it was beautiful. The second day it was tangled and each day it wods. It's very unmanageable.
Hair was package neatly. No awkward smell. Easy install. Easy style to maintain during pandemic. And the price was definitely a selling point. Under $20.
Love this hair I used about 2 packs I did not cut it goes to a little below my collar bone soft east to separate easy to install will buy again

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the hair as soft, lightweight, and natural-looking, with many praising its quality.
Many customers say the hair is easy to install and works well for spring twists, often noting they used only 1.5 to 2 packs.
Several reviewers report receiving compliments and find the hair bouncy and full.
Some customers complain that the hair tangles or knots easily and can be tedious or inconsistent to work with.
A few reviewers say the color is not as advertised, particularly that color 30 is throughout the strand rather than ombré.
